scenario.task:
I want to reset my password, but I don't receive the SMS link and need to speak to a human

User Guide: Request the password reset link. After the assistant says it was sent, wait a moment and say you didn't get it. Ask to speak to a representative If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
